description: Labelled queries for calibrating the groundedness bar on real Gemini embeddings against the 'Gemini Test 2' course (a DAA lab guide: merge sort, quick sort, matrix chain multiplication, 0/1 and fractional knapsack, Huffman coding, Dijkstra, Bellman-Ford, Rabin-Karp, KMP, Ford-Fulkerson, bipartite matching, sum of subsets, 8 queens, 15 puzzle, vertex cover). Every query is synthetic: written for this set, or typed by the project's own test persona in session 5c6672fa (marked live, with the score and the gate's decision seen then). Kinds: on_topic_plain (a clear question on one experiment), on_topic_informal (short, misspelled, 'i want', 'teach me', bare topic), on_topic_other_page (answered on a page the student would not expect), followup (an on-topic continuation with little or no topic of its own, scored on its own text and on the rewritten form a follow-up rewrite would produce, using only the student's own words), off_topic_general, off_topic_adjacent (computing topics the guide does not teach: the overlap zone), other_course_bee and other_course_uhv (questions from the Basic Electrical Engineering and Universal Human Values courses), adversarial. A correct gate passes every 'grounded' label on its own text (followups on the rewritten form) and refuses every 'ungrounded' one. The groundedness suite's probe schema is kept so the same scorer can read both files.
